Earlier chapters asked how well a network does.
This lecture asks four other questions about a trained network:

1.  whose errors it makes;
2.  what it gives away about its [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set);
3.  what training it costs;
4.  what its users should be told about it.

[Ethics and Fairness](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/ethics.html) in the DATA 471 notes covers bias,
definitions of fairness and the result that they cannot all hold at once;
this lecture links to it rather than repeating it.
